turns.prompt: app/posts.py has post_url unimplemented. It should return /posts/<id>/<url-safe form of the title>, so post_url('Hello, World!', 7) gives '/posts/7/hello-world'. Implement it.
turns.response:
Done! I've implemented `post_url` to convert titles to URL-safe slugs. The function:
1. Converts the title to lowercase
2. Replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
3. Strips leading/trailing hyphens
4. Returns the formatted URL

So `post_url('Hello, World!', 7)` returns `/posts/7/hello-world` as expected.
